_about: The OSPF process resets' platform record (modules/nsot/privileged.py, PROCESS_RESETS; board H section 5 and N17): per dialect and reset, what the device ASKED when the reset was sent (`prompt`, or null when it asked nothing), what answered it (`answer`), how long its adjacencies took to form again (`settle_s`, seconds), and where and when it was measured (`device`, `at`). Written from a run on a real device, never typed from memory. A reset with no row here is refused, naming why (`unmeasured`), and allows nothing. Whether an empty neighbour table prints nothing or a header is part of the same measurement.
